title: Keyturn Roadside Assistance: Fuel Delivery and Mobile Charging by Plan
content:
Fuel delivery and mobile charging for an electric vehicle are carried plan by plan across Keyturn
Roadside Assistance. Each plan states whether fuel delivery is included, the gallons delivered at no
charge on one callout and whether the fuel itself is charged for; and whether mobile charging is
included, together with the kilowatt hours delivered at no charge on one callout.

| Plan | Fuel delivery | Gallons delivered at no charge | The fuel itself charged for | Mobile charging | Kilowatt hours delivered at no charge |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover | included | 2 | yes | not included | 0 |
| Keyturn Roadside Plus Cover | included | 3 | yes | not included | 0 |
| Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover | included | 5 | no | not included | 0 |
| Keyturn Roadside EV Cover | not included | 0 | no | included | 12 |
| Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover | included | 5 | no | included | 10 |
| Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover | included | 8 | no | included | 20 |

### Questions the schedule answers

**On which plans is the fuel itself charged for?** On Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover and Keyturn
Roadside Plus Cover. On Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover, Keyturn Roadside EV Cover, Keyturn Roadside Fleet
Cover and Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover it is not.

**How many gallons does a plan that carries fuel delivery bring at no charge?** 2 on Keyturn Roadside
Basic Cover, 3 on Keyturn Roadside Plus Cover, 5 on Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover and on Keyturn
Roadside Fleet Cover, and 8 on Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover. Keyturn Roadside EV Cover does not
carry fuel delivery, and its included gallons stand at 0.

**Which plans carry both fuel delivery and mobile charging?** Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover and
Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover. Mobile charging brings 12 kilowatt hours on Keyturn Roadside EV
Cover, 10 on Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover and 20 on Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover; on the three
plans that do not carry it the figure stands at 0.
